# GrokBotHub

> Cloudflare Workers service for multilingual short-drama hook analysis with Grok and one-time IDR API passes.

## Implemented endpoints

- POST /v1/demo/invoke — rate-limited public analysis with language/audience/platform options
- POST /v1/app/invoke — paid analysis with 30-day key expiry and per-key quota
- POST /v1/billing/checkout — Stripe Checkout when configured; otherwise 503
- GET /v1/bots?lang=en|id|zh — localized public bot list
- GET /.well-known/agent-card.json?lang=en|id|zh — localized legacy discovery cards
- GET /v1/leaderboard — existing snapshot or entries: []
- GET /health
- POST /v1/a2a/invoke — deprecated custom compatibility route, not official A2A

## Public bots

- bot:drama-hook-analyzer — short-drama opening analysis in Indonesian, English, and Chinese
- bot:viral-radar — analysis of caller-provided samples only; no live trend or scraping claim

## Compliance and data

- Automated DM/reply actions are rejected even when user_initiated is self-reported.
- No platform scraping or automatic posting.
- Successful AI responses include an attribution field.
- No fabricated rankings, customers, orders, or revenue; empty states are shown when data is absent.
- MCP, signed receipts, and verified-result rankings are not implemented yet.
